answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 431 Country: ZA Title: What are the rulings of having walima? How soon after the meeting of the bride & groom should walima be held? Question: What are the rulings of having walima? How soon after the meeting of the bride & groom should walima be held? Answer ID: 431 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 191/L) (1) When husband and wife meet first time, it is recommended for husband to invite his relatives and friends to a feast ( walima ) as per his capacity. (2) The walima can be held in the morning or the other day. Inviting people to a feast after that will not be called as walima : ولیمة العرس سنة و فیھا مثوبة عظیمة وھی اذا بنی الرجل بامر أ تہ ینبغي ان یدعو الجیران والاقرباء الی قولہ ولاباس بان یدعوا یومئذ من الغد و بعد الغد ثم ینقطع العرس و الولیمة (عالمگیري: 5/343 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
